Sebi sets up sub-group under PMAC to review key IPO norms; NSE's Chauhan to head panel
summary: Sebi has established a sub-group within its Primary Market Advisory Committee aimed at reassessing regulations related to IPOs and fundraising. The initiative seeks to streamline compliance requirements to foster easier access to capital markets. Key focal points include promoter capital lock-in terms, pricing strategies, and due diligence obligations. The group will evaluate relevant Sebi circulars for potential modifications, with final recommendations to be presented to the PMAC for review.

title: Retain capital gains tax on equities, economists tell FM Sitharaman ahead of Budget 2027-28
summary: Economists recently met with Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman to discuss the upcoming Union Budget for 2027-28. They recommended keeping the capital gains tax on equities, opposing industry requests for its abolition. Meeting discussions highlighted the economic improvements and private investment growth, emphasizing the importance of fiscal prudence. Additionally, they suggested boosting the MSME and labor-intensive sectors for employment opportunities.

title: Blackstone REIT to buy majority stake in $5 billion Amazon data center portfolio
summary: Blackstone Digital Infrastructure Trust has officially announced its commitment to acquire a 75.1% stake in joint ventures alongside Amazon Web Services. This significant deal values the AWS data center portfolio at around $5 billion, marking a bold entry into the market. The portfolio features 13 newly constructed powered shells with long-term leases back to AWS.

title: Warren Buffett donates $5.47 billion in Berkshire Hathaway shares to charities, confidence in successors remains 'strong as ever'
summary: Warren Buffett announced a donation of approximately $5.47 billion in Berkshire Hathaway shares to various charities. This donation consists of 9,225,000 Class B shares allocated to four foundations. Following this contribution, he has donated over $29 billion of his Berkshire stock to those organizations. Despite the donation, Buffett retains around 13% of Berkshire's stock ownership. He remains confident in the leadership of the conglomerate he built over 60 years.

title: India's investments in US Treasuries jump USD 38.4 bn in Jun-Aug amid FCNR flows
summary: India's investment in US Treasury securities increased by USD 38.4 billion due to FCNR(B) deposits during three months. The Reserve Bank of India introduced a special facility to encourage these foreign currency deposits. This facility led to significant inflows, improving India's foreign exchange reserves substantially. Experts suggest that investment in US Treasuries may slow down due to the closure of the FCNR(B) window. India's reserves grew to USD 740.

title: Hong Kong debuts offshore yuan bond index to promote RMB assets
summary: Hong Kong stock exchange has introduced its inaugural benchmark for offshore yuan bonds to enhance global yuan usage. A dozen asset managers are set to utilize this index for new investment products. The initiative aligns with China's ongoing efforts to internationalize the yuan currency due to geopolitical factors. This launch builds on previous measures to boost the offshore yuan market and develop related infrastructure.

title: India bonds dip as elevated inflation fuels rate hike expectations
summary: Indian government bonds have taken a hit, driven by increased selling pressures and fears of imminent interest rate hikes. The benchmark bond yield climbed slightly, mirroring movements in US Treasuries. In light of fresh inflation data, expectations have intensified for rate increases in both the US and India, leading analysts to modify their inflation outlook for an upcoming RBI meeting.

title: Nvidia's AI financing machine may survive Huang, but with less risk appetite
summary: The $500 billion AI financing platform from Nvidia may wobble after Jensen Huang's departure. Analysts are wary about the impact of increasing interest rates, which could slow down new investments. Meanwhile, Nvidia's financial partners remain active in talks surrounding AI financing. A clear shift towards more traditional players may emerge, steering clear of the riskier neocloud investments.

title: Morgan Stanley raises global equities to 'maximum overweight' on cheap valuations, earnings strength
summary: Morgan Stanley has adopted a maximum overweight stance on global equities for 2027, buoyed by attractive valuations and promising earnings growth perspectives. With an S&P 500 index target of 8,700 points, indicating a potential rise of more than 15%, the firm displays confidence in Japan and Europe based on flourishing investment trends and positive economic conditions. Furthermore, expectations predict that elevated energy costs will level off by late 2027.
